description: Predicts a student's CGPA using the client node's local model. Accepts all 30 student features and returns the predicted CGPA, performance tier, risk flag, and model metadata.

detail.msg: ensure this value is less than or equal to 10.0

503.detail: Local model is not trained yet. Call /local/train-and-sync or /local/refresh-weights first.

notes: All 30 features are required. Categorical fields (parent_education, region_state, family_income, gender, region_type) must use the exact string values listed in the schema. Binary fields (internet_access, scholarship, part_time_job) accept 0 or 1. Performance tiers: Excellent (8.5–10.0), Good (7.0–8.5), Average (5.0–7.0), At-Risk (0.0–5.0). The risk_flag is true when predicted CGPA falls in the At-Risk tier.
